title: How to Submit a Support Ticket
text:
## How to Submit a Support Ticket
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000001966
Our team is always happy to help. All support is handled through email/tickets and our documentation center, we strongly encourage all site owners to read up and learn as much as they can as this makes the daily management of the site easiest.
Feel free to email our support team for help with the BD website: support@brilliantdirectories.com

## Submit a Ticket
The ticket can be submitted from the admin by clicking on Create New Ticket.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12174873294/original/SLZzInw4TSDhVz7V-3BvNrhBuD5EK96FIg.png?1771442918 | alt: ]

## Create New Ticket Form
This will open up the " Create New Ticket " form.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12174873922/original/uJe7WoR-3AMRyIlRK10UPE4Cr_ttdK9P7g.png?1771443594 | alt: ]

## Support Ticket Form Fields
Use this form to submit a support request by selecting the website and ticket type, then adding a clear subject, detailed explanation, and optional link/attachments for context.
Selects the specific website the support request relates to, so the ticket is routed and reviewed in the correct account context.
Selects the ticket category/type to help classify the request and ensure handling by the right team.
Adds a direct URL to the page where the issue occurs, making it easier to review and reproduce the problem.
A short, clear summary of the request (used as the ticket’s title in the ticket list).
The full description of the request, including context, steps taken, what’s expected, and what’s currently happening.
Uploads supporting files (screenshots, documents, or other relevant files) to help demonstrate the issue or provide examples.
